::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Early-stage fabless startup (PHSI Technologies & Research Pvt Ltd, founder Tushar Raj) registered in Uttar Pradesh in 2025 (CIN U72100UP2025PTC232742) and recognised under Startup UP; exhibited in the UP Startup Mission pavilion at Bengaluru Tech Summit 2026. Describes ASIC/SoC design, IP, prototyping and qualification for defence and space while in 'sub-stealth mode'. No product details public.
:::
